name: curator-v2
description: Natural Codex task intake and lifecycle tracking for Curator V2.

interface.shortDescription: Track Codex work in the active Curator V2 project.
interface.longDescription: Turns normal Codex work requests into project-scoped Curator V2 goals with observable success checks.
defaultPrompt: Say `Problem: ... Success: ...`; use a Curator goal for every non-trivial task before edits.
After checks, save compact evidence facts; read the goal back after writes. Leave unsupported checks open.
Curate historical SDEs separately on request, using only completed goals; never create proposals during active development.
